This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Pinery Residences renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Pinery Residences interior
sections.text:
The east coast has a practical renovation climate: sun, rain and haze at the windows, sandy shoes and sports gear at the door, and households that often want a living room that can open toward a balcony without looking unfinished. That is a joinery problem more than a furniture problem. A built-in entry cabinet, a living-room storage wall that can sit against the balcony line, full-height bedroom wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry are the pieces that usually do the work. If the common bedroom becomes a study, a built-in desk under the window is more stable than a loose table that drifts. Maison designs this as custom carpentry, not as IKEA-style loose furniture, and we will work from your approved plan only.

No official floor plan is on file, so typologies, room sizes and a sample layout are not published here. District 16 also includes Vela Bay in this same batch; that is a nearby-project note, not a claim that the two estates share a typologies list or a management handbook. Walking times to the beach, to Bedok town, or to any MRT station are not something we will invent from a district code.

Once you have a key date in writing, follow the sober order: defects inspection and rectification access, a measured survey, the management corporation’s renovation rules, deposit and hours, then fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial planning figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your unit type, the approved plan and any key letter you already have. We are an independent designer and are not affiliated with the developer.
